from fractions import Fraction as F
# Isolated exact arithmetic illustration, not a project implementation/test.
def advance(s,b,w,h,k=100000,m=F(1,100),y=F(1,2),rq=F(0),rg=F(0)):
    if s==0 or b==0: return dict(s=s,b=b,w=w,rq=rq,rg=rg,q=0,g=0,accepted=True)
    mu=m*s/(k+s); a=mu*h; x=F(b)*a/y
    if a>F(1,100) or x>F(s,100): return dict(accepted=False,a=a,x=x)
    zq=x+rq; q=zq.numerator//zq.denominator; rq=zq-q
    zg=y*q+rg; g=zg.numerator//zg.denominator; rg=zg-g
    assert 0<=g<=q<=s
    out=dict(s=s-q,b=b+g,w=w+q-g,rq=rq,rg=rg,q=q,g=g,accepted=True,a=a,x=x)
    assert out['s']+out['b']+out['w']==s+b+w
    return out
